notes.title: Layers of Fear: the Series Crowning Work Is Coming out Next Month
notes.content:
Bloober Team's venture into horror began with the Layers series; the upcoming Layers of Fear will be the series' most important work and is scheduled to launch in June 2023. Developed in collaboration with Anshar Studios, it promises to deliver fresh gameplay, chapters, and a visually stunning experience. Here's a brief look at what awaits our dear players.

[h2]Game Content[/h2]

The series’ upcoming magnum opus is the definitive way to experience the critically acclaimed franchise as it features Layers of Fear and Layers of Fear 2, as well as all DLCs (including the new ‘The Final Note’ DLC that will give you a new perspective on the Layers of Fear storyline) and the never-before-told story of The Writer, which will tie everything together. Built on Unreal Engine 5, Layers of Fear supports Ray Tracing, HDR, and 4K resolution to make the stunning visuals, and your nightmarish experience, as immersive and realistic as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210324/7f5ba1257926ee64f62f35db18789fcffb8fffa1.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Preview[/h2]

Check out our latest 11-minute gameplay video and get ready to immerse yourself in the horrors that await new players and long-time fans of the Layers of Fear series. Witness the unveiling of the new mechanic, the lantern, and take a sneak peek at the gameplay in a new setting — inside a lighthouse.

[previewyoutube=hVioJM_lKwU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Next-Generation Graphics[/h2]

In addition to introducing brand new chapters and gameplay elements, Layers of Fear also demonstrates the impressive potential of Unreal Engine 5 - it's one of the very first games to date that were built with the newest technology. Take a look at the game's stunning graphics in a showcase video here.

[previewyoutube=iMkN8whZQmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

There's much more to learn about the game, go check out the Layers of Fear's Steam card for more information. Keep a close eye there as our developers host streams about the game from time to time.

Don't forget to share your comments and insights in the comment section of the news. Thanks for following!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/

notes.title: GET LOST IN THE WOODS. BLOOBER TEAM BRINGS FEAR TO PC VR
notes.content:
Bloober Team is excited to share Blair Witch: VR Edition is now available Steam. Optimized for PC VR platforms, Blair Witch: VR Edition will be available on Steam for $29.99. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1576350/Blair_Witch_VR/

Blair Witch: VR Edition is an addition to the line-up of Blair Witch VR experiences previously only available on Oculus devices. The redesigned environments allow for more interactivity and accommodate new creature encounters. 

Watch the Blair Witch: VR Edition announcement trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W8kX1JOWUBM

Blair Witch: VR Edition is also now available on PSVR. Watch the Live-Action Trailer: https://youtu.be/EC3AqMjMeOQ 

Features:
Improved Dog commands for Bullet:
●	Pet Bullet to make sure he knows he's a good boy
●	Change up his look with a variety of new collars
●	Give Bullet treats. In the VR edition, he'll take them right from your hand
●	Bullet can help you track scents through the forest, just give him an object to sniff
●	Enjoy the company of your best buddy and shake his paw any time
 
Gameplay:
●	Environments have been redesigned for more interactivity
○	Objects to catch, throw, or stack on top of each other 
○	A marker to draw on paper and other objects
○	Drawers, doors, gates, and car trunk open at a touch
○	Breaking branches 
○	Operation of mechanical elements: handles, buttons, opening locks with a key, padlock codes, etc...
●	New control system 
●	New sounds and in-game events to surprise and scare the player.
●	Additional creature encounters
●	Unlockable Achievements and Trophies

Blair Witch: VR Edition is a story-driven psychological horror game from the creative minds behind the critically acclaimed Layers of Fear. Experience first-hand the toll that fear can take on the mind in an original story inspired by the cinematic lore of Blair Witch, designed for virtual reality.

The Blair Witch story has been rebuilt for PC head-mounted displays. With environments redesigned for more interactivity, new mechanics for your companion dog such as petting and fetching gestures, and additional creature encounters, you will experience the eerie atmosphere of the Black Hills Forest like never before. These cursed woods will awaken your darkest fears.
 
Find more about Blair Witch: VR Edition at:
●	https://www.facebook.com/BlairWitchGame/
●	https://www.facebook.com/BlooberTeam/
●	https://twitter.com/blairwitchgame
●	https://twitter.com/BlooberTeam
●	https://www.youtube.com/user/blooberteam
●	https://blairwitchgame.com/

notes.title: Blair Witch “Good Boy Pack” Update
notes.content:
Today, Bloober Team, the creative minds behind the critically acclaimed Layers of Fear games, in partnership with global content leader Lionsgate (NYSE: LGF.A, LGF.B), call you back to the Black Hills Forest with the release of Blair Witch “Good Boy Pack”. 

Players are now able to customize their canine companion in various ways to make Bullet their very own and personal “good boy” with the addition of the appropriately named “Good Boy Pack”; which will include new dog skins; new in-game cellphone games, wallpapers, and content; and new animations for Bullet - making him even more realistic. The “Good Boy Pack” is also available on PC via Steam©.

notes.title: Technical patch #2 is LIVE!
notes.content:
As we promised yesterday - Technical Patch # 2 is LIVE! In addition to the fixes we wrote, we've also added some new stuff.

So, the most important thing first: we finally fixed the issue about getting stuck in various locations in the game. We hope that you will not encounter that sort of problem anymore...


1. More sticky spots fixed:
* near the logs in Chapter 0
* near the rock passage in Chapter 13
* In the huge cave in Chapter 14
2. Fixed dog behaviour around the bunker in Chapter 4.
3. Fixed some issues with pausing dream sequences.
4. Fixed gameplay issues in Chapter 14.
5. Fixed the issue where inventory could be blocked during the cutscene before Chapter 17.
6. Fixed the very rare bug during cutscene that blocked the progress in Chapter 10.
7. Various fixes to Bullet in Chapter 13.
8. Fixed the very rare issue where picking up walkie in Chapter 12 could block the progress.
9. Fixed an issue where after Bullet carrying sequence in Chapter 14 your sensitivity would become very low.

Tweaks:
1. Tweaks to Bullet so he doesn't go where he's not supposed to (ie. bear snares).
2. Tweaks to tracks visibility in Chapter 12.
3. Tweaks to items visibility in Chapter 3 and Chapter 7.

We’re still working on other improvements and also on update for Xbox and PC Windows store.

----

Previous patch note

1. Sticky spots - works are still in progress but we identified and fixed several instances:
- near the fallen bridge in Chapter 4
- near the stream in Chapter 4
- around the swamps in Chapter 6
- near the generator in Chapter 8
- near the fallen trees in Chapter 8
- when walking with Bullet in Chapter 14
- many other various locations

2. Fixed the situation when Bullet was losing track near the fallen bridge in Chapter 4
3. Fixed the situation when Bullet was behaving incorrectly during monsters encounters
4. Fixed angles on the "Dog wheel"
5. Addition od LPV in Advanced tab

notes.title: Technical patch #2 coming on Wednesday
notes.content:
Next patch for Blair Witch is coming and You can expect it about tomorrow noon CEST. We’ve focused on removing gameplay bugs like:

1. Sticky spots - works are still in progress but we identified and fixed several instances:
- near the fallen bridge in Chapter 4
- near the stream in Chapter 4
- around the swamps in Chapter 6
- near the generator in Chapter 8
- near the fallen trees in Chapter 8
- when walking with Bullet in Chapter 14
- many other various locations

2. Fixed the situation when Bullet was losing track near the fallen bridge in Chapter 4
3. Fixed the situation when Bullet was behaving incorrectly during monsters encounters
4. Fixed angles on the "Dog wheel"
5. Addition od LPV in Advanced tab

Important note: if you get stuck in collisions in the game, always try to crouch and move away from the obstacle. It should fix the problem in 99% of all instances!

We also want to announce that work on big Windows Store and Xbox update is nearly finished. We will do our best to deliver it before the weekend!

notes.title: First technical patch is LIVE!
notes.content:
As we promised here’s the latest technical patch for Blair Witch Game: It repairs most of bugs You mentioned in comments. Some of others are still under construction or in testing. So now we can say that more updates are on their way

Patch notes:

- a rare fuse bug in a car that blocked game progress
- entering the car in the woods
- bugs referred to entering the cutscene
- other various situations that caused the player stuck in the game
- visual effects at levels
- first optimization corrections - and that’s not the last word
- rare bug about entering the cabin [as there is a rock]
- dog performance, now it goes smoothly
- visual improvement of some cutscenes, especially final ones
- ultra wide support for 3440x1440
- HDR support

IMPORTANT: News for the Windows Store and Game Pass players: we are testing the update pack and we will launch it ASAP.

notes.title: Patch is LIVE
notes.content:
Apparently, we underestimated the power of the Blair Witch's curses. We are aware that some of you have been experiencing performance issues and have prepared a patch that should fix some of the bigger optimization problems, live now. We will continue to fine-tune in the coming days and welcome your additional comments. Also, you can now save your preferences in advanced menu - as it should be. 

Thank you to everyone who gave feedback. We’d love it if you could re-review the game if you have a chance to play the game as intended. 

If you downloaded the game prior to the patch, please reach out to us and we'll send you a free download code for The Blair Witch Project within 7 days (hopefully sooner) and a code for BRAWL from Bloober TEAM. 

For the codes just send us an email with your STEAM nickname: support@blairwitchgame.com. 

Should any other issues arise, contact us here or by mail.

Stay safe!
